# Keep the localization namespace rename consistent with current Mach call sites

The exact owned-path blob checks prove that 1014 reverses 1011. 1011 changes the import back to direct inspect_migration, prepare_object_dir and test_migration names while the already changed call sites still use fmt; prepare_directories had replaced prepare_object_dir in 1010. 1015 restores import tb_l10n.tb_migration_test as fmt and changes the source repository organization. Current Mach keeps the fmt import and prepare_directories call. These are exact source differences; the DONTBUILD backout message does not state the failure cause.

Scope: Localization rename and Mach import backout chain.
